subject.title: gateway install/status hardcodes ~/Library/LaunchAgents — prevents boot-without-login on macOS

question: What privileged macOS LaunchDaemon contract should OpenClaw support for gateway install/status on headless hosts?
rationale: This decides root-owned plist mutation, sudo/operator UX, non-root `UserName`, durable environment handling, and coexistence with user LaunchAgents, so code inspection alone cannot choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Explicit audited system scope
options.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as the default and add a clear `--system` or equivalent flow with status, doctor, lifecycle, docs, and tests aligned around privilege-safe behavior.

options.title: Diagnostic guidance only
options.body: Do not manage LaunchDaemons yet; make status and doctor clearly detect system services and point operators to manual launchctl commands.

options.title: Defer LaunchDaemon support
options.body: Keep the custom LaunchDaemon workaround outside OpenClaw until maintainers are ready to own the privileged service surface.

recommendation.title: Explicit audited system scope
recommendation.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as the default and add a clear `--system` or equivalent flow with status, doctor, lifecycle, docs, and tests aligned around privilege-safe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal ties steipete to gateway service lifecycle ownership, launchd helper work, and prior maintainer-facing review context for this cluster.
